data.description: Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/response#d4): Attach three pre-named branches to the trial verdict. (i) Disputes vanish: build the account's fuller written system, weekly reset included. (ii) Disputes mutate into what-counts, exceptions, or standards fights: move to domain ownership or rotating full weeks with turn-picking or credit-bidding for the unequal split, or buy cleaning if budget allows; an exposed imbalance of effort is handled here by renegotiating the split itself, absorbing a7. (iii) Trial refused, gamed, or yielding no recordable agreements: one structured one-time ownership conversation, then unilateral scope declaration, then the viability question.
